scenario_id.description: Scenario identifier (base case or a sensitivity scenario) [-] (source: config/sweep)

technology.description: Allocated cooking technology (or 'total') [-] (source: summary: Max benefit technology)

households_reached.description: Households for which this tech is optimal [households] (source: summary: Households (Millions) ×1e6)

population_reached.description: Population for which this tech is optimal [people] (source: summary: Population (Million) ×1e6)

net_benefit_usd_per_hh_yr.description: Annualised net benefit per household [USD/household/yr] (source: derived: total_net_benefit_usd / households_reached)

total_net_benefit_usd.description: Total net benefit for this tech×scenario [USD] (source: summary: Total net benefit (MUSD) ×1e6)

tco2_per_hh_yr.description: Avoided emissions per household per year [tCO2e/household/yr] (source: derived: total_tco2 / households_reached)

total_tco2_mt_yr.description: Total avoided emissions per year [Mt CO2e/yr] (source: summary: Reduced emissions (Mton CO2eq))

deaths_avoided.description: Premature deaths avoided per year [deaths/yr] (source: summary: Total deaths avoided (pp/yr))

time_saved_hours.description: Time saved (cooking + collection) per household per day [hours/household/day] (source: summary: hours/hh.day)

mac_usd_per_tco2.description: Marginal abatement cost, EX carbon revenue [USD/tCO2e] (source: derived)

carbon_revenue_npv_usd_per_hh.description: NPV of carbon credit revenue per household over the crediting period [USD/household] (source: derived: tco2_per_hh_yr × carbon_price × annuity(crediting_period, discount))

capex_usd_per_hh.description: Up-front capital cost per household [USD/household] (source: derived: Investment costs (MUSD) ×1e6 / households_reached)

fuel_cost_usd_per_hh_yr.description: Annual fuel cost per household [USD/household/yr] (source: derived: Fuel costs (MUSD) ×1e6 / households_reached)

fnrb.description: Fraction of non-renewable biomass used [fraction] (source: config)

fnrb_source.description: Provenance of the fNRB value [-] (source: config)

vsl.description: Value of a statistical life [USD/life] (source: config)

model_version.description: OnStove code version / git sha that produced the run [-] (source: provenance)

run_timestamp.description: When the run was executed [ISO-8601 UTC] (source: provenance)

validation_status.description: Whether this row is validated against a published figure [-] (source: provenance)
